inherited_methods.loss_step: quantifies over a fixed terminal rank R and then chooses q above every A_n,B_n canonical wall through R
inherited_methods.lost_information: the first rank at which a fixed actual q meets a B-tail carry wall and the exact canonical word after that wall
inherited_methods.consequence: it proves no uniform fixed recovery rank but does not decide the adaptive recovery caused by the first real carry

inherited_methods.loss_step: retains the same H/q staircase and bottom recurrence while allowing only A_n(q),B_n(q) to vary
inherited_methods.lost_information: a canonical carry changes a q-scale leading digit and therefore exits the hypotheses of the no-go
inherited_methods.consequence: the pointwise negative bound cannot test a true wall-crossing switch

inherited_methods.loss_step: treats alpha,delta,beta,v as proposed coefficients without deriving them from a greedy Macaulay before/after word
inherited_methods.lost_information: uniqueness, digit ordering, wall location, and the algebraic coupling between leading gain and bottom transfer
inherited_methods.consequence: alpha+delta>=3 is necessary bookkeeping but may describe no legal transition

inherited_methods.loss_step: records first nonnegative ranks and signs but not the canonical cell inequalities causing the sign change
inherited_methods.lost_information: an all-parameter description of which carry occurs first and why its surplus has the required sign
inherited_methods.consequence: large positive examples cannot be promoted to adaptive recovery

inherited_methods.loss_step: stops once a local gamma_n is nonnegative
inherited_methods.lost_information: whether the seed maps to the inherited diagonal capacity and persists through the suffix construction
inherited_methods.consequence: even a legal local switch does not close the public Erdos-776 interface

required_new_information: literal greedy Macaulay words immediately before and after a candidate carry or borrow wall
an exact Pascal identity deriving, rather than assigning, alpha and delta
all digit-order inequalities on an infinite actual parameter family
the equality-case constant or a strict positive surplus bound
a precise separation between local adaptive recovery and public suffix persistence
